standard: llms.txt community specification (Answer.AI, September 2024) — robots.txt Crawl-delay directive

cases.why: Crawl-delay: 300 on the GPTBot stanza — Number(300) > 60 threshold and 'gptbot' is in the tracked AI_CRAWLERS list; AI_ROBOTS_DELAY_EXCESSIVE set to true
Crawl-delay: 86400 under User-agent: * — Number(86400) > 60 and agent is wildcard, causing applyCrawlDelay() to set delayExcessive=true for all AI crawlers
